rules.rule: A missing target skill is refused; the updater never creates it

assertions.value: does not exist, stop and report

rules.rule: The target skill is resolved as a lowercase kebab-case ID
Only the seven listed categories are accepted as update scope

assertions.value: responsibility, scope, out-of-scope,\s+workflow, rules, acceptance criteria,\s+readme

rules.rule: Missing inputs are requested in one batched question before any edit
Only the requested categories are edited; everything else stays untouched
Rules changes are handed to skill-testing so spec and Rules table stay covered bidirectionally
The rule-test runner must be GREEN before success is reported
The description still states when to use the skill
The report includes before/after evidence and the test results
An incomplete update request is answered by asking, never by writing files
The first output line announces the skill invocation

assertions.value: ▶ Skill invoked: Skill Updater — update an existing skill and keep its rule tests GREEN
